1. (Original) A method for providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the method comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.

2. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes data represents certificates selected by a user.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code.

4. (Original) The method of claim 3 wherein the certificate authorization code includes an electronic coupon authorization code.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a short message service (SMS) message containing a uniform resource locator (URL) link to a web page displaying a barcode.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control short message service (SMS) message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

7. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein establishing a communications link with a mobile device comprises: sending a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data; and receiving, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data.

8. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising: storing the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device as a softcard coupon and personalization data.

9. (Original) The method of claim 8 further comprising: storing the personalization data within at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device.

10. (Original) The method of claim 9 further comprising: communicating the personalization data to a wireless device reader in order to conduct a purchase transaction.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the certificate selection device includes at least one of a personal computer, a kiosk station, and a smart poster.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first near field communication (NFC) enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second near field communication (NFC) enabled mobile device.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for electronically providing a electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __wherein the certificate selection device generates the certificate selection information based on user interaction with the certificate selection device, and wherein the electronic value certificate data is generated by the merchant server based on merchant-specific certificate templates__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard electronic coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes data represents certificates selected by a user, __and wherein the personalization data includes user-specific information that distinguishes the electronic value certificate from generic certificate templates__.

15. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code __that is generated by the merchant server and is distinct from any coupon identification used by the merchant server for internal tracking__.

16. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 15 wherein the certificate authorization code includes an electronic coupon authorization code __that is generated specifically for authorizing the electronic value certificate transaction__.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a short message service (SMS) message containing a uniform resource locator (URL) link to a web page displaying a barcode __wherein the barcode is generated by the merchant server based on the certificate selection information__.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control short message service (SMS) message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information __wherein the barcode image is generated by the merchant server__.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to send a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data, and receive, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data __wherein the download request includes authentication information provided by the mobile device__.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to upload the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device as a softcard coupon and personalization data __wherein the personalization data is generated by the merchant server based on the recipient data__.

21. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 20 wherein the personalization data is provisioned to at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device __wherein the personalization data includes merchant-specific authentication credentials__.

22. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 21 wherein the mobile device is adapted to communicate the personalization data to a wireless device reader in order to conduct a purchase transaction __wherein the personalization data enables verification of the electronic value certificate by the merchant server__.

23. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the certificate selection device includes at least one of a personal computer, a kiosk station, and a smart poster __wherein the certificate selection device is configured to communicate with the merchant server via a secure communication protocol__.

24. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the mobile device comprises a first near field communication (NFC) enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second near field communication (NFC) enabled mobile device __wherein the transfer includes merchant-specific authentication data__.

25. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory computer readable medium having stored thereon computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.
